item.title: New Ways to Explore NHL Shootouts
item.description: Explore shot location maps, quick scouting reads, detailed statistics, and player paths to understand how shootouts unfold. Plus, a first look at DeepHockeyVision.

item.title: My Team Canada 2026 Roster
item.description: My picks for the 2026 Team Canada Olympic roster. Analysis of the mix between proven talent (Crosby, McDavid) and the new guard (Bedard, Celebrini).

item.title: More Power Play Minutes Are Given Early in the Season
item.description: Data from the past two seasons reveals October power play minutes average 14.64 and 12.69 per game—significantly higher than later months. This early-season penalty surge creates a critical strategic window that smart teams can exploit for competitive advantage.
